title: pinus pyrenaica subsp. mauretanica
intro: Pinus pyrenaica subsp. mauretanica, commonly known as Moroccan pine or Atlas pine, is a subspecies of evergreen coniferous tree native to the mountainous regions of Morocco and Spain. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to support respiratory health, with reported benefits including relief from bronchitis, coughs, and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Pinus pyrenaica subsp. mauretanica include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Pinus pyrenaica subsp. mauretanica include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, such as pinosylvin and pinocembrin, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
